english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: — Përshëndetje, Luan! Jam unë, Sam.
sentences.english: "Hello, Luan! It is me, Sam."

sentences.text: — Përshëndetje, Sam! Si je?
sentences.english: "Hello, Sam! How are you?"

sentences.text: — Jam mirë, faleminderit. Po ti?
sentences.english: "I am well, thank you. And you?"

sentences.text: — Edhe unë jam mirë, por sot kam shumë punë.
sentences.english: "I am well too, but today I have a lot of work."

sentences.text: — Pse je i lodhur?
sentences.english: "Why are you tired?"

sentences.text: — Sepse kjo javë është e gjatë. Duhet të punoj çdo ditë.
sentences.english: "Because this week is long. I have to work every day."

sentences.text: — Edhe unë duhet të shkoj në shkollë çdo ditë.
sentences.english: "I too have to go to school every day."

sentences.text: — Ti mëson shumë shqip. Je një shok i mirë.
sentences.english: "You learn a lot of Albanian. You are a good friend."

sentences.text: — Faleminderit, Luan. Kur vjen te unë?
sentences.english: "Thank you, Luan. When are you coming to me?"

sentences.text: — Nesër punoj në shkollë. Tani nuk kam kohë.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow I work at school. Now I have no time."

sentences.text: — Po të dielën?
sentences.english: "And on Sunday?"

sentences.text: — Të dielën shkojmë në kishë. Ti vjen me ne?
sentences.english: "On Sunday we go to church. Are you coming with us?"

sentences.text: — Po, vij me ju. Zoti është i mirë.
sentences.english: "Yes, I am coming with you. The Lord is good."

sentences.text: — Pse e thua këtë?
sentences.english: "Why do you say that?"

sentences.text: — Sepse kjo javë është e gjatë, por unë jam i lumtur. Faleminderit Zotit!
sentences.english: "Because this week is long, but I am happy. Thank God!"

sentences.text: — Kur do të vish pastaj te unë?
sentences.english: "When will you come to me after that?"

sentences.text: — Pastaj vij te ti, me Anën dhe me Dritanin.
sentences.english: "After that I come to you, with Ana and with Dritan."

sentences.text: — Ana dhe Dritani vijnë me ju?
sentences.english: "Ana and Dritan come with you?"

sentences.text: — Po, ata vijnë me ne. Ne pimë kafe bashkë.
sentences.english: "Yes, they come with us. We drink coffee together."

sentences.text: — Mirë. Pse nuk vjen edhe Ardi?
sentences.english: "Good. Why is Ardi not coming too?"

sentences.text: — Ardi duhet të shkojë te gjyshja. Ajo është në treg.
sentences.english: "Ardi has to go to his grandmother. She is at the market."

sentences.text: — Ai shkon sot dhe nesër. Ju vini të dielën.
sentences.english: "He goes today and tomorrow. You come on Sunday."

sentences.text: — Mirë, Luan. Çdo javë ti je shoku im i mirë.
sentences.english: "Good, Luan. Every week you are my good friend."

sentences.text: — Edhe ti je një njeri i mirë. Faleminderit për çajin!
sentences.english: "You too are a good person. Thank you for the tea!"

sentences.text: — S'ka përse. Ja, kafe dhe çaj për ne.
sentences.english: "You're welcome. Here, coffee and tea for us."

sentences.text: — Tani shkoj. Kur flasim nesër?
sentences.english: "Now I go. When do we talk tomorrow?"

sentences.text: — Nesër pas shkollës. Ti më thua çfarë bën.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow after school. You tell me what you do."

sentences.text: — Mirë. Dëshiroj të di çfarë mëson ti.
sentences.english: "Good. I want to know what you learn."

sentences.text: — Unë mësoj shqip dhe ti më thua çfarë mendon.
sentences.english: "I learn Albanian and you tell me what you think."

sentences.text: — Mirë, Luan. Faleminderit për ditën e mirë!
sentences.english: "Good, Luan. Thank you for the good day!"

sentences.text: — Faleminderit edhe ty, Sam!
sentences.english: "Thank you too, Sam!"
